newsitem.title: USA: Female Health to distribute condom in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Female Health to distribute condom in Europe.

text.p: Female Health Co said Wednesday its manufacturing subsidiary in London received accreditation to distribute its female condom throughout the European Union.

With accreditation from Lloyd's Register Quality Assurance, the Reality-brand female condom will now carry the Conformite Europeene mark and will be available for marketing by potential partners in Europe, Female Health said.
The female condom was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in 1994, the company said.
Female Health owns certain worldwide rights to the Reality condom. Its shares were trading up 1/16 Wednesday at 3-15/16.
